method: Static read-only audit of the assigned trailing 27 Web test/fixture files (contract indices 28-54). Read each file's AST-derived imports, complete local function/variable fixture text, hooks, test declarations and parameterizations, assertions, and call/effect inventory. Read all 520 supplemental assignment/update/throw/branch/loop and independent screen.findBy implicit-assertion records. Full original-source semantic reads of preview-server.mjs and process-remote.test.tsx; further original-source review of the organization setup, WebRTC peer/stream setup, xterm/FitAddon and terminal Api adapter, and FileEditor write/receipt/storage-failure paths. Cross-checked root Vitest mock cleanup configuration before assessing the storage spy. Early oversized/truncated output was not used to claim completeness; affected contract material was reread in bounded projections. This is complete coverage of the assigned contract-review scope, not a claim that every remaining test body or production implementation received a full original-source read. No tests, browser sessions, remote services, or prior implementation/history were used in this sub-review.

mockBoundaries.transport: Real Api plus local fetch routing used for operation identity/recovery tests; direct call/mutate fakes are limited to explicitly scoped rendering/interaction assertions. Delayed fake responses deliberately survive abort where ownership rejection is the target.
mockBoundaries.media: WebRTC peer, microphone tracks, HTMLMediaElement playback, object URLs and downloads are synthetic; this review does not establish real-device or browser integration behavior.
mockBoundaries.terminal: xterm/FitAddon and ResizeObserver are mocked for grid/input/output ownership contracts; terminal creation recovery has separate real-Api/local-fetch cases.
mockBoundaries.cleanup: vitest.config.ts explicitly sets clearMocks:true and restoreMocks:true; per-file cleanup and unstub hooks were checked. No missing-spy-cleanup finding was inferred solely from an absent local restore call.

additionalSourceReads.reason: Verified global spy cleanup configuration; outside the 27-file counted assignment.

validation.staticParse: All 27 sources parsed by rolldown parseAst during supplemental extraction, without executing test code.
